description: Evaluates lexical TF-IDF and inductive LSA/TruncatedSVD retrieval against 32 benchmark tasks with normalized gold target pointers.
note: Inductive LSA and Lexical TF-IDF are diagnostic retrieval baselines, not end-to-end execution arms or live neural embedding models.

protocol_specification.tfidf_protocol: Query-Inclusive / Transductive: Vocabulary and inverse document frequency weights are fitted across the joint corpus of schema constraint chunks plus task queries, serving as a transparent lexical baseline.
protocol_specification.lsa_protocol: Inductive Latent Semantic Analysis: TfidfVectorizer (unigrams to trigrams, sublinear TF) and TruncatedSVD (16 dimensions, random_state=42) are fitted strictly on schema chunk texts; evaluation task queries are projected out-of-sample into latent space.

token_accounting_impact.observation: After strict gold-label normalization, Inductive LSA semantic retrieval achieves 16.15% macro recall at k=2, with 21 of 32 tasks (65.6%) failing to retrieve any gold constraint label. Lexical TF-IDF achieves 15.62% macro recall at k=2 with 21 of 32 tasks (65.6%) zero-recall. This demonstrates that offline semantic/lexical retrieval alone cannot reliably expose required enterprise rules without reactive in-tree recovery.
